reason: Single-frame pseudo-label selection and no-train teacher variants have been sufficiently explored for the current development population. Five selection tracks and three no-train teacher probes all failed to improve fine keypoint localisation over the synthetic-only model, and PAPER_EVAL has now been consumed as a development population by every one of them. Further variants designed against the same population cannot produce confirmatory evidence.
forbidden_next_without_new_protocol: re-designating a better-scoring arm as the Proposed method after the fact
allowed: table generation from existing result artifacts
typo and bug fixes that do not change any reported metric
a future independent study under a separately frozen protocol and a population that has never been consulted

stopped_before_it_started.what_it_would_have_been: fine-tuning R0 on 402 real manual-GT frames from challenge/data/01_real/live_capture_gt under the identical exposure contract, with pseudo-labels replaced by human labels
stopped_before_it_started.why_it_was_blocked_anyway: A delegated convention audit found that 106 of the 402 candidate label frames (26.4 percent) violate the left-right corner ordering that the source model was trained under, and that 187 of 402 have a keypoint_annotations field that is stale by a 90 degree permutation relative to projected_cuboid. The labels would have taught the very failure mode the experiment was meant to fix.
stopped_before_it_started.kept_for: provenance — it records a track that was designed, audited, and stopped before consuming any compute

what_would_reopen_experimentation: a target-domain evaluation population that has never been used for development
a training-label source whose keypoint index convention has been verified against the source model's convention
a protocol frozen and committed before any result on that population is observed

immutable_prior_artifacts.rule: V1 through V5 result JSON, per-frame CSV, teacher caches, checkpoints, pseudo manifests, method locks, exposure locks, filter locks, FAST teacher results, and previously generated result tables are historical experiment records and are never edited.
